\n\n

वैकल्पिक विधि \\(\\rm \\frac{\\cos^2 θ}{\\cot^2 θ + \\sin^2 θ -1} \\) = 3

\n\n

मूल्य निर्धारण विधि द्वारा

\n\n

θ = 30° पर

\n\n

\\(\\rm \\frac{\\cos^2 θ}{\\cot^2 θ + \\sin^2 θ -1} \\ne 3 \\)

\n\n

θ = 60° पर

\n\n

\\(\\rm \\frac{\\cos^2 θ}{\\cot^2 θ + \\sin^2 θ -1} = 3 \\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\frac{1/4}{1/3 + 3/4 - 1}\\) = 3

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\frac{1/4}{1/12}\\) = 3

\n\n

⇒3 = 3 (संतुष्ट, LHS = RHS)

\n\n

अब, tanθ + cosecθ

\n\n

⇒ tan60° + cosec60°

\n\n

⇒ √3 + \\(2\\over\\sqrt3\\) = \\({3+2}\\over\\sqrt3\\) = \\(5\\over\\sqrt3\\)

\n\n

जिसे \\(5\\sqrt3\\over3\\) के रूप में भी लिखा जा सकता है

\n\n

∴(tanθ + cosecθ) का मान \\(5\\sqrt3\\over3\\) है।

Given:

\n\n

ΔABC ~ ΔPQR and \\(\\rm \\frac{ar(\\Delta ABC)}{ar (\\Delta PQR)} = \\frac{144}{49}\\) 

\n\n

 AB = 12 cm, BC = 7 cm,  AC = 9 cm

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

\n\n

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of the squares of the corresponding sides.

\n\n

\\(\\text{Area of (ΔABC)}\\over{\\text{Area of (ΔPQR)}}\\) = \\(({{AC}\\over{PR}})^2\\)

\n\n<", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

ΔABC ~ ΔPQR और \\(\\rm \\frac{ar(\\Delta ABC)}{ar (\\Delta PQR)} = \\frac{144}{49}\\) 

\n\n

 AB = 12 सेमी, BC = 7 सेमी,  AC = 9 सेमी

\n\n

अवधारणा:

\n\n

\n\n

दो समरूप त्रिभुजों के क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात संगत भुजाओं के वर्गों के अनुपात के बराबर होता है।

\n\n

\\(\\text{Area of (ΔABC)}\\over{\\text{Area of (ΔPQR)}}\\) = \\(({{AC}\\over{PR}})^2\\)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

\\(\\text{Area of (ΔABC)}\\over{\\text{Area of (ΔPQR)}}\\) = \\(({{AC}\\over{PR}})^2\\) 

\n\n

⇒ \\(144\\over49\\) = \\(({{AC}\\over{PR}})^2\\) 

\n\n

⇒ \\(AC\\over PR\\) = \\(\\sqrt{144\\over49} \\) = \\(12\\over7\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(9\\over PR\\) = \\(12\\over7\\)

\n\n

⇒ PR = \\({9\\times 7}\\over12\\) = \\(21\\over4\\) सेमी

\n\n

∴ PR = \\(21\\over4\\) सेमी 

\n\n178:T6c6,\n

\n\n

\n\n

ఇచ్చినది:

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

భావన:

\n\n

\n\n

రెండు సరూప త్రిభుజాల వైశాల్యాల నిష్పత్తి వాటి అనురూప భుజాల వర్గాల నిష్పత్తికి సమానం.

\n\n

లెక్కింపు:

\n\n

\\(\\text{Area of (ΔABC)}\\over{\\text{Area of (ΔPQR)}}\\) = \\(({{AC}\\over{PR}})^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(144\\over49\\) = \\(({{AC}\\over{PR}})^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(AC\\over PR\\) = \\(\\sqrt{144\\over49} \\) = \\(12\\over7\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(9\\over PR\\) = \\(12\\over7\\)

\n\n

⇒ PR = \\({9\\times 7}\\over12\\) = \\(21\\over4\\) సెం.మీ

\n\n

∴ PR = \\(21\\over4\\) సెం.మీ

\n\n185:Tb6d,\n

Given:

\n\n

Profit percent = 21% 

\n\n

Discount percent = 21% 

\n\n

Formulas used:

\n\n

Discount % = Discount/ Printed Price × 100 

\n\n

Selling Price = Printed price - Discount 

\n\n

Selling Price - Cost Price = Profit 

\n\n

Profit % = Profit/Cost price × 100 

\n\n

Calculation: 

\n\n

Given:

\n\n

Profit percent = 21% 

\n\n

Discount percent = 21% 

\n\n

Formulas used:

\n\n

Discount % = Discount/ Printed Price × 100 

\n\n

Selling Price = Printed price - Discount 

\n\n

Selling Price - Cost Price = Profit 

\n\n

Profit % = Profit/Cost price × 100 

\n\n

Calculation: 

\n\n

Let the printed price be = 100

\n\n

Discount percentage is calculated on printed price. 

\n\n

Discount % = Discount/ Printed Price × 100 

\n\n

⇒ 21 = Discount/100 × 100 

\n\n

⇒ Discount = 21 

\n\n

Selling Price = Printed price - Discount 

\n\n

⇒ 100 - 21 = 79 

\n\n

Profit is calculated on the Cost Price. 

\n\n

Profit % = Profit/Cost price × 100 

\n\n

⇒ 21 = (Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost price × 100 

\n\n

⇒ 21 = (79 - CP)/ CP × 100 

\n\n

⇒ 21CP = 7900 - 100CP 

\n\n

⇒ 121CP = 7900

\n\n

⇒ CP = 7900/121

\n\n

∴ Cost Price/Selling Price = 7900/121 ÷ 79

\n\n

⇒ 100 : 121 

\n\n

Alternate MethodLet the Printed Price be 100

\n\n

Selling Price = Printed Price (100 - Discount%) = (100 - 21)× Printed Price

\n\n

Selling Price = 79% × Printed Price

\n\n

Selling Price = (100 + Profit%) × Cost Price 

\n\n

Selling Price = 121% × Cost Price  

\n\n

∴ Cost Price : Selling Price = 100 : 121

\n\n

∴ क्रय मूल्य : विक्रय मूल्य = 100 : 121

ছাড়ের শতাংশ চিহ্নিত মূল্যের উপর গণনা করা হয়।

\n\n

ছাড় % = ছাড়/ চিহ্নিত মূল্য × 100

\n\n

⇒ 21 = ছাড়/100 × 100

\n\n

⇒ ছাড় = 21

\n\n

বিক্রয়মূল্য = চিহ্নিত মূল্য - ছাড়

\n\n

⇒ 100 - 21 = 79

\n\n

লাভ ক্রয়মূল্যের উপর গণনা করা হয়।

\n\n

লাভ % = লাভ/ক্রয়মূল্য x 100

\n\n

⇒ 21 = (বিক্রয়মূল্য - ক্রয়মূল্য)/ক্রয়মূল্য x 100

\n\n

⇒ 21 = (79 - ক্রয়মূল্য)/ ক্রয়মূল্য x 100

\n\n

⇒ 21ক্রয়মূল্য = 7900 - 100ক্রয়মূল্য

\n\n

⇒ 121ক্রয়মূল্য = 7900

\n\n

⇒ ক্রয়মূল্য = 7900/121

\n\n

∴ ক্রয়মূল্য/বিক্রয়মূল্য = 7900/121 ÷ 79

\n\n

⇒ 100 : 121

\n\n

Alternate Methodধরা যাক চিহ্নিত মূল্য 100

\n\n

বিক্রয়মূল্য = চিহ্নিত মূল্য (100 - ছাড়%) = (100 - 21)× চিহ্নিত মূল্য

\n\n

বিক্রয়মূল্য = 79% × চিহ্নিত মূল্য

\n\n

বিক্রয়মূল্য = (100 + লাভ%) × ক্রয়মূল্য

\n\n

বিক্রয়মূল্য = 121% × ক্রয়মূল্য

\n\n

∴ ক্রয়মূল্য : বিক্রয়মূল্য = 100 : 121

Given:

\n\n

When x is subtracted from each of 19, 28, 55 and 91, the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

As per the question; 

\n\n

(19 - x)/(28 - x) = (55 - x)/(91 - x)

\n\n

⇒ (19 - x) × (91 - x) = (28 - x) × (55 - x)

\n\n

⇒ 1729 - 19x - 91x + x2 = 1540 - 28x - 55x + x2

\n\n

⇒ 189 = 27x

\n\n

∴ x = 7

\n\n

Given:

\n\n

Chord = 21cm 

\n\n

Diameter = 25 cm 

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

The perpendicular drawn from the center on the chord, bisects the chord in two equal parts. 

\n\n

Pythagoras Theorem:

\n\n

OA2 = OD2 + AD2

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let AB be the chord of length 21 cm. 

\n\n

⇒ OD be the perpendicular distance 

\n\n

⇒ AO be the radius of the circle 

\n\n

OA2 = OD2 + AD2

\n\n

⇒ (25/2)2 = OD2 + (21/2)2

\n\n

⇒ 625/4 = OD2 + 441/4 

\n\n

⇒ OD2 = 625/4 - 441/4 = 184/4 = 46 

\n\n

Given:

\n\n

Principal = Rs.8192

\n\n

Time = \\(1 \\frac{1}{4}\\) years or 15 months 

\n\n

Rate = 15% Per annum 

\n\n

⇒ Rate as per 5-monthly basis = 5/12 × 15 = 25/4% 

\n\n

Formulas used:

\n\n

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal 

\n\n

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)n

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Time period = 3 (15 months/5)

\n\n

Rate as per 5-monthly basis = 5/12 × 15 = 25/4% 

\n\n

Compound Interest = 8192 × (1 + 25/4 ÷ 100)3 - Principal 

\n\n

⇒ 8192 × (1 + 1/16)3 - 8192 = 8192 [ 17/16 × 17/16 × 17/16 - 1] 

\n\n

⇒ 8192 [(4913 - 4096) ÷ 4096] 

\n\n

⇒ 8192 × 817/4096

\n\n

⇒ 1634 

\n\n

∴ Compound Interest = Rs.1634

\n\n

Alternate MethodBy Fraction Method 

\n\n

Rate = 25/4% =  25/4× 100 = 1/16 

\n\n

CI is calculated on Principal, so it will be the base (100%) for the interest. 

\n\n

Rate % = Rate/100 = Interest/Principal 

\n\n

⇒ Interest/Principal = 1/16 

\n\n

Interest = Amount - Principal 

\n\n

⇒ Amount = 1 + 16 = 17 

\n\n

Time Period = 3 (5-monthly) 

\n\n

\\(=\\frac{Principal}{Amount}=\\left(\\frac{16}{17}\\right)^{n}=\\frac{16^3}{17^3}\\)

\n\n

⇒ 8192/ Amount = 4096/4913

\n\n

⇒ So, if 4096 = 8192,

\n\n

So, Compound Interest (4913 - 4096) = 817; 

\n\n

⇒ 817 = 817/4096 × 8192 = 1634

\n\n

∴ Compound Interest = Rs.1634

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

\n\n

5-मासिक आधार पर दर = 5/12 × 15 = 25/4%

\n\n

⇒ 8192 × (1 + 1/16)3 - 8192 = 8192 [ 17/16 × 17/16 × 17/16 - 1] 

\n\n

⇒ 8192 [(4913 - 4096) ÷ 4096] 

\n\n

⇒ 8192 × 817/4096

\n\n

Alternate Method भिन्न विधि द्वारा 

\n\n

दर = 25/4% = 25/4× 100 = 1/16 

\n\n

CI की गणना मूलधन पर की जाती है, इसलिए यह ब्याज का आधार (100%) होगा। 

\n\n

दर% = दर/100 = ब्याज/मूलधन 

\n\n

⇒ ब्याज/मूलधन = 1/16 

\n\n

ब्याज = मिश्रधन - मूलधन 

\n\n

⇒ मिश्रधन = 1 + 16 = 17 

\n\n

समय अवधि = 3 (5-मासिक) 

\n\n

\\(=\\frac{Principal}{Amount}=\\left(\\frac{16}{17}\\right)^{n}=\\frac{16^3}{17^3}\\)

\n\n

⇒ 8192/मिश्रधन = 4096/4913

\n\n

⇒ इसलिए, यदि 4096 = 8192,

\n\n

इसलिए, चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (4913 - 4096) = 817; 

\n\n

⇒ 817 = 817/4096 × 8192 = 1634

\n\n

∴ चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 1634 रुपये

\n\n

Given:

\n\n

XP = PQ = QY 

\n\n

Ratio of time taken by boat to go from X to Q and Y to Q = 4 : 5

\n\n

Formulas used:

\n\n

Speed of the boat going downstream = (Speed of the boat + Speed of the current)

\n\n

Speed of the boat going upstream = (Speed of the boat - Speed of the current)

\n\n

Time = Distance/Speed 

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let XP = PQ = QY = d 

\n\n

Let the speed of the boat = a km/h

\n\n

Let the speed of the current = b km/h

\n\n

As per the question:

\n\n

2d/(a + b) ÷ d/(a - b) = 4/5 

\n\n

⇒ 2(a - b)/(a + b) = 4/5 

\n\n

⇒ 14b = 6a 

\n\n

⇒ a/b = 7/3

\n\n

Speed of the boat downstream = (7 + 3) = 10

\n\n

Speed of the current = 3 

\n\n

∴ The required ratio = 10 : 3

", "hn": "\n

\n\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

XP = PQ = QY 

\n\n

नाव द्वारा X से Q और Y से Q तक जाने में लगे समय का अनुपात = 4 : 5

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

धारा के अनुकूल जाने वाली नाव की गति = (नाव की गति + धारा की गति)

\n\n

धारा के प्रतिकूल जाने वाली नाव की गति = (नाव की गति - धारा की गति)

\n\n

समय = दूरी/गति 

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

माना XP = PQ = QY = d 

\n\n

माना नाव की चाल = a किमी/घंटा 

\n\n

माना धारा की गति = b किमी/घंटा

\n\n

प्रश्न के अनुसार:

\n\n

2d/(a + b) ÷ d/(a - b) = 4/5 

\n\n

⇒ 2(a - b)/(a + b) = 4/5 

\n\n

⇒ 14b = 6a 

\n\n

⇒ a/b = 7/3

\n\n

नाव के अनुप्रवाह की गति = (7 + 3) = 10

\n\n

धारा की गति = 3 

\n\n

∴ अभीष्ट अनुपात = 10 : 3

\n\n

অনুসৃত সূত্র:

\n\n

স্রোতের অনুকূলে যাওয়া নৌকার গতিবেগ = (নৌকার গতিবেগ + স্রোতের গতিবেগ)

\n\n

স্রোতের প্রতিকূলে যাওয়া নৌকার গতিবেগ = (নৌকার গতিবেগ - স্রোতের গতিবেগ)

\n\n

সময় = দূরত্ব/গতিবেগ 

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

মনে করি, XP = PQ = QY = d

\n\n

নৌকার গতিবেগ = a কিমি/ঘন্টা

\n\n

স্রোতের গতিবেগ = b কিমি/ঘন্টা

\n\n

প্রশ্ন অনুযায়ী:

\n\n

2d/(a + b) ÷ d/(a - b) = 4/5

\n\n

⇒ 2(a - b)/(a + b) = 4/5

\n\n

⇒ 14b = 6a

\n\n

⇒ a/b = 7/3

\n\n

স্রোতের অনুকূলে নৌকার গতিবেগ = (7 + 3) = 10

\n\n

স্রোতের গতিবেগ = 3

\n\n

∴ নির্ণেয় অনুপাত = 10 : 3

Given:

\n\n

Income of A is 45% more than the income of B

\n\n

Income of C is 60% less than the sum of the incomes of A and B

\n\n

Income of D is 20% more than that of C

\n\n

The difference between the incomes of B and D is Rs.13200

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let the income of B = 100 

\n\n

⇒ Income of A = 100 × 145/100 = 145

\n\n

Income of C = (100 + 145) × 40/100 = 98

\n\n

Income of D = 98 × 120/100 = 117.6

\n\n

The difference between income of D and B = 117.6 - 100 = 17.6

\n\n

⇒ 17.6 = Rs.13200 

\n\n

∴ Income of C = 13200 × 98/17.6 = Rs.73500

\n", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

A की आय, B की आय से 45% अधिक है। 

\n\n

C की आय, A और B की आय के योग से 60% कम है। 

\n\n

D की आय, C की आय से 20% अधिक है। 

\n\n

B और D की आय के बीच का अंतर 13200 रुपये है। 

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

माना B की आय = 100 

\n\n

⇒ A की आय = 100 × 145/100 = 145

"value": "26°"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "32°"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given:

\n\n

∠ADC = 78° and ∠BEC = 52°

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

The sum of a pair of opposite angles is 180° of a cyclic quadrilateral. 

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\n\n

Now, In quadrilateral ABCD,

\n\n

∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180° (Sum of opposite angles are 180°)

\n\n

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° - 78° = 102° 

\n\n

∠EBC = 180° - 102° = 78° [Linear Pair]

\n\n

In ΔBEC,

\n\n

∠BEC + ∠EBC + ∠BCE = 180° 

\n\n

⇒ 52° + 78° + ∠BCE = 180° 

\n\n

⇒ ∠BCE = 180° - 130° = 50°

\n\n

⇒ ∠BCE = ∠DCF = 50° (Vertically opposite angle)

\n\n

∠ADE + ∠FDC = 180° [Linear Pair]

\n\n

⇒ ∠FDC = 180° - ∠ADE = 180° - 78° = 102°

\n\n

In ΔDCF,

\n\n

∠FDC + ∠DCF + ∠DFC = 180° 

\n\n

102 + 50 + ∠DFC = 180° 

\n\n

∠DFC = 180° - 152° = 28° 

\n\n

∠DFC = ∠AFB = 28° 

\n\n

∴ The measure of ∠AFB is 28°.

\n\n

Key Points

\n\n
    \n\t
  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
    • \n\t
  • In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
    • \n\t
  • The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the present continuous tense.
    • \n\t

                • Sentence C will come after B because it explains the possible source of the smoke.

                  The correct answer is 'we will have' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

                  \n\n

                  Key Points

                  \n\n
                    \n\t
                  • In the given sentence, the use of the simple future tense ''will have'' is incorrect.
                    • \n\t
                  • The given sentence is the third conditional sentence explaining that present circumstances would be different if something different had happened in the past.
                    • \n\t
                  • The third conditional sentence format: past perfect, modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.)​ + have + past participle.
                    • \n\t
                  • When using the third conditional, we use the past perfect (i.e., had + past participle) in the if-clause and the modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.) + have + past participle in the main clause.
                    • \n\t
                  • Therefore, the past form of the verb 'would' should be used in place of the simple future form of the verb 'will'.
                    \n\t 
                    • \n
                  \n\n

                  Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

                  \n\n

                  Correct sentence: Had you not reached in time, we would have lost our lives.

                  \n\n

                  \n\n
                    \n\t

                    • \n\t

                    • \n\t
                  • अतः verb 'will' के simple future form के स्थान पर past form of the verb 'would' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
                    \n\t 
                    • \n
                  \n\n

                  अतः सही उत्तर option 4 है।
